voice.heroSubcopy: Casa Argentera, a historical village situated in a small catalan mountain village, between the famous wine region Priorat and the Mediterranean Sea

heroImage.alt: View of the pool heated and lighted in Casa Argentera
heroImage.notes: First of 5 Revolution Slider slides (lazy data-lazyload src); slider fills the first viewport under the overlaid header. Rect not measured by the census; intrinsic 1980×1114.

voice.heroMediumNotes: Hero is an auto-advancing image slideshow (Revolution Slider 6, 5 slides, data-duration 2500, fade). Not a video/canvas/Lottie, so heroMedium is null; the slideshow itself is captured as module hero-slider.
voice.firstParagraph: A place where time stands still, and unique traditions stays alive. Situated in a valley, in a tiny authentic Catalan village with cobblestone streets lined with ever blooming flowers and a majestic view of the castle of Escornalbou. A place where your story begins.
heroSlideCaptions: Unique traditions / SMALL AUTHENTIC CATALAN VILLAGE
Amazing moments / HERE YOUR STORY BEGINS

tone.evidence: warm, sensory hospitality copy ("A place where time stands still", "Here your story begins", "The time is yours"); first-person-plural hosts (Albert & Ina); light non-native English (e.g. "stays alive", "acces", "appartment")

narrative.northStar: The Village House in Afternoon Light
narrative.overview: A warm, photo-led holiday-rental brochure: every page opens on a full-width slideshow of the house and its landscape, then settles into white pages where thin amber Montserrat headlines and small grey body text frame square-cornered photographs. Amber is the only brand colour; it carries headings, the translucent header band, buttons, icon chips and the full-bleed footer.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, no shadows, square imagery
Round only for controls: 25px buttons, circular icon chips
Enquiry form as the universal closer

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only chromatic colour; everything else is white or grey.

rules.name: The Thin Headline Rule
rules.body: Display headings are Montserrat 200, never bold.

rules.name: The Flat Brochure Rule
rules.body: No shadows; depth comes from photography.

dos: Do open content pages with a full-width photo slideshow.
Do set h2 at 50px/55px weight 200 in #dd9d3b.
Do use 25px-radius amber pills for buttons.
Do close program, events and booking pages with the enquiry form.
donts: Don’t add shadows or card chrome to image blocks.
Don’t introduce a second accent colour.
